description: This PHP class defines a ScheduledInterviewSummary that implements the ActionSummary interface. It summarizes scheduled interviews for candidates, providing counts of actionable items and categorization details. The class uses a trait for service functionalities and manages candidate IDs to generate the summary.

classes.name: ScheduledInterviewSummary
classes.description: A PHP class implementing ActionSummary to provide a summary of scheduled interviews, including count and group information, using external service traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a list of candidate IDs that are accessible.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the fixed group ID for scheduled interviews, which is 5.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name for this summary: 'Candidates To Interview'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Returns the count of scheduled interviews requiring action, fetched via a service DAO method.
